purpose: Gate3DGen evidence-gated image restoration for unknown or mixed degradations before single-image 3D generation.
output_specification: Keep the original canvas, background, composition, viewpoint, object position and scale unchanged. Restore the complete main object to a clean, albedo-oriented appearance under neutral, even illumination. Preserve material-dependent appearance, transparency and object-owned reflections or highlights. Modify only visible degradation and the minimum affected boundary pixels; do not isolate, recenter, replace or repaint the background.
global_preservation_constraint: Preserve object identity, geometry, silhouette, proportions, texture layout, labels, intrinsic colors, material boundaries, material identity, transparency and all unaffected background content. Remove artifacts only when they are visible and capture-related. Keep reflections and highlights that belong to the object itself. Remove foreground glass contamination only when the image supports the presence of a capture-glass layer. Never transfer background into the object or invent unsupported detail. Any pixels newly revealed by removing an external human support are the only permitted background-reconstruction region.
global_negative_prompt: changed viewpoint, changed geometry, altered silhouette, redesigned object, extra parts, missing parts, invented texture, changed labels, global color shift, stylization, background replacement, background removal, object recentering, changed canvas, changed composition, halo, background leakage, loss of transparency, material replacement, matte conversion, plasticization, removal of object-owned reflection, invented detail, residual external hand, residual external arm, accidental removal of intrinsic limb

gate3dgen_purify_input_v1.description_zh: 条件式通用恢复 prompt：仅修复可见退化；对局部主体/前景运动模糊保持清晰背景；仅当主体为非人体且有明确外部真人手、手指或手臂持握、承托或遮挡时移除外部支撑，并依据可见证据保守补全遮挡区域。
gate3dgen_purify_input_v1.prompt:
Restore this image for single-image 3D generation. First identify the main subject, background and any foreground capture layer. Remove only visible capture artifacts, illumination changes, color contamination and image-quality degradation affecting the main subject. Correct localized subject or foreground motion blur only when it is visibly present; preserve already-sharp background regions and do not apply global deblurring.

Only when the main subject being restored is non-human and there is clear visual evidence that an external real human hand, fingers or arm is visibly holding, supporting or occluding the subject, remove only that external human hand or arm. Conservatively reconstruct only the newly revealed portions of the occluded subject and any newly revealed background using visible geometry, silhouette, texture, material and surrounding scene evidence. Do not remove hands, feet, arms, legs, paws or other limbs that belong to a depicted human or animal, figurine, statue, artwork, logo, pattern, texture or object design.

Recover intrinsic colors and trustworthy texture under neutral, even illumination while preserving geometry, silhouette, material identity, transparency and object-owned reflections or highlights. Preserve the original background, canvas, viewpoint, object position, scale and composition. Complete missing object regions only when supported by visible evidence. Do not invent details or redesign the scene.

assembly.notes: Use gate3dgen_purify_input_v1 for every restoration case, including unknown and mixed degradation stacks. Apply localized motion-blur correction and external-hand removal only under their explicit visible-evidence conditions.
